msItem.author: བསྐལ་བཟང་རྒྱ་མཚོ (bskal bzang rgya mtsho)
msItem.note: "Folios 40 and 245 missing. Title page and f.1v and f.2.r have Lentsa script and Sanskrit transliterated in Tibetan; ff.1v and 2.r have decorative drawings. On title page pencilled ""Tib.a.107"""
msItem.incipit: na mo gu ru many+dzu g+ho Sha sva ra svast+yai/ dag pa rab 'byams brtan dang g.yo ba yi/ /ngo mtshar kun byed lhan cig skyes ba'i gar/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bar mngon bzhengs bcom ldan 'das/ /bla ma dang po'i mgon por phyag 'tshal lo/ /bem chos las 'das rang snang ye shes kyi/ /gzhal med rin chen brgya las bzhu blugs dbus/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i bkod pa de la 'dud/
msItem.explicit: rang blo gsang chen gyi chos la rnam par 'byed pa'i rtsal stobs zhan yang rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i legs bshad 'gran zla med pa'i dbang don de nyid rab gsal dang sngags rim chen mo gzhir bzung / gzhan yang rje yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi rigs dang / dbang bskur gyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud tshig ..... g.yar khral tsam du rje bla ma'i bstan pa la shes nas dad pa thob pa shAkya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa'i tha shal ba blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshos rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang gru 'dzin gnyis par don grub ces pa sa lug lo'i dbyug zla'i yar gyi gral tshes lnga pa lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub pa'i sbyor ba sogs dus dge bar rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mchod dpon zha lu mkhan pos bgyis pa 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i gsang chen bla med kyi bshad sgrub phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //
